scenario: Stores + Prices Drop + Sitemap + Supplier pages
methodology: curl + UA simulation (iPhone Safari iOS 17, Chrome 145 Windows)

findings.details: The 'Our Stores' page is completely inaccessible across all languages. This is a core PrestaShop feature (store locator). 404 pages have full responsive infrastructure (18 offcanvas, 7 hamburger, 12 hreflang, 303 ARIA in ES) but the content layer is broken.
findings.fix_hint: Check if Stores module/feature is enabled in BO or if friendly URLs need configuration.

findings.summary: Prices Drop returns 404 in ES, FR, DE. Only /en/prices-drop is 200 OK
findings.details: REGESSION: /es/bajamos-precios was 200 OK in 2026-05-09 03:21 test, now returns 404. /fr/prix-en-baisse and /de/preisnachlass also 404. Only English works. This blocks users from seeing discounted products in 3 of 4 languages.
findings.fix_hint: Check friendly URL configuration for prices-drop controller in ES/FR/DE.

findings.summary: /en/prices-drop shows Title 'New products' and H1 'New products' instead of 'Prices drop'
findings.details: The only working Prices Drop page (EN) displays incorrect labels: both <title> and <h1> say 'New products' when they should say 'Prices drop' or equivalent. Likely a template/i18n string issue — the New Products page strings are being reused.
findings.fix_hint: Check translations for prices-drop controller — may be using new-products strings as fallback.

findings.summary: /fr/plan-de-site returns 404. ES, EN, DE sitemaps are 200 OK
findings.details: French sitemap page is inaccessible. ES (/es/mapa-del-sitio), EN (/en/sitemap), and DE (/de/sitemap) return 200 OK.
findings.fix_hint: Missing friendly URL entry for sitemap in French.

findings.summary: ES, EN, DE sitemap pages (200 OK) lack responsive infrastructure: no viewport meta, no BS grid, no offcanvas/hamburger, no hreflang
findings.details: Sitemap pages render as bare HTML without any responsive infrastructure. Missing: viewport meta tag, Bootstrap grid columns, offcanvas mobile menu, hamburger toggle, hreflang alternate links. Page size is 1.25MB (ES) suggesting full-page renders without mobile optimization.
findings.fix_hint: Sitemap controller needs to extend the main theme layout to inherit header/footer/responsive infrastructure.

findings.details: Supplier/manufacturer detail page for zonacnc brand returns 404. This could affect vendor storefront visibility. The manufacturers listing page (/es/fabricantes) was confirmed 200 OK in previous tests.
findings.fix_hint: Check if supplier 1 has active products and if the friendly URL is correctly configured.

passes: Homepage ES/EN/FR/DE: 200 OK, viewport meta, BS grid (7 cols), 18 offcanvas, 7 hamburger, 24 flex, 12 hreflang, 208-310 ARIA
Mobile = Desktop body: IDENTICAL across all pages (server-side rendering consistent)
CSS media queries: 286 total across 6 CSS files (listings.css:14, mobile-nav.css:3, consent.css:1, widget.css:1, savedsearch.css:1, theme-74ef8b52.css:266)
404 pages have full responsive infrastructure: viewport meta, BS grid, offcanvas, hamburger, hreflang, ARIA
Sitemaps ES/EN/DE: 200 OK (though lacking responsive infra)
All pages maintain 12 hreflang alternate links (where header present)
comparison_previous: Pricedrops ES was 200 OK at 2026-05-09 03:21, now 404 (REGRESSION). Stores pages never tested before. Sitemap responsive infra never tested before. Supplier page never tested before.
regression_summary: 1 REGRESSION (pricedrops ES 200→404). 5 NEW findings. Stores all-404 is the most impactful — core PS feature completely blocked.
